docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I work with real estate developers, land investors, architects, and government decision-makers who cannot afford ambiguity—because unclear or outdated land information inevitably shows up as approval delays, boundary disputes, redesigns, capital loss, and reputational risk.

I am the Founder of Spatialcraft, where we help stakeholders replace assumptions with verified ground truth at the very first step of a project—before designs are frozen, approvals are sought, or capital is committed.

My approach integrates high-resolution aerial surveys, physically validated DGPS/GNSS ground data, and advanced spatial analysis into smart, reliable outputs—delivered in CAD-ready formats and through our award-winning Smart Interactive Digital Maps (SIDM™) platform, a system for spatial decision-making.

Architects design on it. Developers plan on it. Investors trust it. Authorities review it.

Over the years, I’ve worked on land due diligence, project site feasibility studies, construction progress monitoring, village-level geospatial mapping, statewide GIS portal development, wetland assessments, and digital planning initiatives across Goa. I have also led citizen-science efforts for village-level water resource mapping and planning.

My goal is simple: bring clarity, precision, and transparency to land and infrastructure decision-making—simplifying complexity through a “one map, all answers” approach.

If you’re planning a project, evaluating land, or exploring geospatial solutions, I’m happy to help you understand what’s possible.

docs.title: Founder — Afonso Spatialcraft LLP
docs.text:
February 2024 – Present | Goa, India

  • Spearhead delivery of innovative GIS solutions, focusing on Smart Interactive Digital Maps (SIDM) for real estate, government services, and infrastructure development.
  • Led the geotagging and mapping project for Smart City Panjim, Goa, covering tree geotagging and urban planning.
  • Integrate CAD and GIS data across platforms such as QGIS and AutoCAD, and collaborate with DGPS survey teams for precise data collection.

docs.title: GIS Consultant — Goa Electronics Limited
docs.text:
April 2023 – Present | Panaji, Goa, India

  • Instrumental in developing the OneMapGoa GIS platform, a decision support system integrating geospatial data for government departments and citizens across Goa.
  • Created the state basemap and integrated utilities data from departments including Electricity, PWD, and WRD using advanced data cleaning, editing, and visualization techniques.
  • Designed technical workflows, established GIS standards, and conducted training workshops for government officials to support e-governance and resource management.

docs.title: Founder — Geosensitive Remote Sensing and GIS Services
docs.text:
July 2019 – Present | Goa, India

  • Lead delivery of advanced GIS and Drone (UAV) Remote Sensing services for clients across Goa and Andhra Pradesh.
  • Submitted IBM compliance reports for mines meeting stringent regulatory standards.
  • Completed agricultural land mapping projects across multiple villages in Goa, providing geospatial insights for local development.

docs.title: Assistant Professor — Parvatibai Chowgule College of Arts and Science (Autonomous)
docs.text:
January 2016 – August 2022 | Margao, Goa, India

  • Designed and delivered lectures and practicals in geology and geospatial sciences, adopting a flipped-classroom approach using ICT tools.
  • Curated and launched new courses including "Remote Sensing and Digital Image Processing" and "GIS for Geoscientists," and supervised final-year research projects.
  • Organised industry seminars, student skill workshops, field training programmes, and conducted a six-day QGIS training for staff of the Directorate of Settlement and Land Records, Goa.

docs.title: Geologist — Soiltech India Private Limited
docs.text:
June 2015 – November 2015 | Kerala & Goa, India

  • Served as site in-charge for a beach sand and offshore investigation project (sonic drilling) in Kerala for the Atomic Minerals Division, Government of India, managing a multinational drilling crew and coordinating with clients.
  • Managed geotechnical investigation of a flyover project in Ponda, Goa, conducting Standard Penetration Tests, soil and rock sampling, and borehole logging.
  • Oversaw seven drilling crew personnel and the operation of two calyx rigs, preparing daily site reports and ensuring safe, efficient project execution.
